The verified FY28 consensus adds about +$13 at 60% weight. Blending with the agents' SOTP/EV legs subtracts. Removing the unverified Anthropic uplift subtracts $4. delta_review.anchoring_check: The blind agent_3 (never saw the 10-02 files) independently found the same inputs: CY27 $14.95, CY28 $17.89 (MarketScreener) and a 21.8x multiple. It lands lower ($346) for four reasons. (1) A skeptic -8% cut to CY28 EPS (judgment). (2) It applies a next-FY multiple to an NTM base, which understates by about 4%. (3) An EV/EBITDA leg at 35% weight ($320). (4) No net cash in its P/E leg. Corrected for (2) and (4) only, it is about $352. So the factual inputs are confirmed independently, and the remaining gap is the skeptic's judgment, not a fact the delta agents inherited. The two delta agents ($362, $370) sit within $4-8 of the 10-02 level, so they are partly anchored, but the inputs they changed (FY28 consensus, peer median) were re-fetched and verified this round.

comps_review.premium_discount: No premium or discount to the 21.7x median, applied to core CY2028 EPS at the horizon. That is a 2.5% discount to GOOGL's own 22.3x core today. For a premium: Cloud +82% with a $513.9B backlog, and top-tier segment margins.
